# VirtualAssistant.com.ph

> VirtualAssistant.com.ph helps businesses hire vetted Filipino virtual assistants. Clients can browse approved talent or submit a private hiring brief, while virtual assistants can apply for jobs and complete the platform's vetting process.

Use the pages below as the primary sources for current information about hiring, pricing, vetting, services, tools, and platform policies. For commercial terms, service fees, compensation guidance, or other information that can change, prefer the current Pricing and FAQ pages over older editorial content. Private candidate evidence, recruiter notes, resumes, contact details, client documents, and authenticated dashboard content are not public resources and are intentionally excluded here.

## Hiring and Vetting

- [Home](https://virtualassistant.com.ph/): Overview of the platform and its approach to hiring vetted Filipino virtual assistants.
- [Hire a Virtual Assistant](https://virtualassistant.com.ph/hire): Submit a private role brief and start the matching process.
- [Find Talent](https://virtualassistant.com.ph/find-talent): Browse approved virtual assistant talent available for public discovery.
- [Pricing](https://virtualassistant.com.ph/pricing): Current client pricing structure, service models, and cost guidance.
- [Managed vs Direct Hire](https://virtualassistant.com.ph/managed-vs-direct-hire): Comparison of the platform's managed-service and direct-hire options.
- [How Vetting Works](https://virtualassistant.com.ph/how-vetting-works): Explanation of the structured candidate screening, recruiter review, approval, and privacy process.
- [FAQ](https://virtualassistant.com.ph/faq): Current answers about hiring, vetting, pricing, privacy, applications, and platform use.

## Services and Role Discovery

- [Virtual Assistant Services](https://virtualassistant.com.ph/services): Directory of virtual assistant specialties and service categories.
- [Industries](https://virtualassistant.com.ph/industries): Virtual assistant support organized by industry.
- [Software Experience](https://virtualassistant.com.ph/software): Virtual assistant pages organized around software and platform experience.
- [What Type of VA Do I Need?](https://virtualassistant.com.ph/tools/what-type-of-va-do-i-need): Guided tool for identifying the type of virtual assistant that fits a workload.

## Tools

- [Virtual Assistant Tools](https://virtualassistant.com.ph/tools): Hub for hiring and cost-planning tools.
- [Virtual Assistant Cost Calculator](https://virtualassistant.com.ph/tools/virtual-assistant-cost-calculator): Estimate virtual assistant compensation and service costs using current configurable inputs.
- [Hourly to Monthly Calculator](https://virtualassistant.com.ph/tools/virtual-assistant-hourly-to-monthly-calculator): Convert an hourly virtual assistant rate and weekly hours into an estimated monthly amount.
- [Job Description Generator](https://virtualassistant.com.ph/tools/virtual-assistant-job-description-generator): Build a virtual assistant job description from role requirements.

## For Virtual Assistants

- [For Virtual Assistants](https://virtualassistant.com.ph/for-virtual-assistants): Information for Filipino virtual assistants using the platform.
- [Jobs](https://virtualassistant.com.ph/jobs): Public virtual assistant job opportunities.
